objectives: Explain how a small action attaches to a routine
Build a habit that needs little willpower
lesson.simple: Small actions turn into habits when you attach them to something you already do. Each repeat makes the next one easier. Like brushing your teeth after breakfast, the routine does the remembering for you.

blocks.title: Idea 0
blocks.body:
In this part we show that a small repeated action becomes a lasting routine when it is attached to something that already happens every day. People who practise it notice that the habit needs less effort each week, which is why the idea is taught first.
